title: Shanta Bhawan
shortDescription: Premium 2 & 3 BHK flats in Sai Nagar, Vasai West starting ₹79.50 Lacs*. RERA approved (P99000080383), G+14 floors, by Sanjari Properties.
description: Shanta Bhawan is a G+14 residential tower by Sanjari Properties, located in Sai Nagar, Vasai West, just behind Sai Nagar Ground. The project focuses on wellness-oriented living, with a jogging track, yoga and meditation zone, and an equipped open gym built into the community. A dedicated senior citizen corner and reliable 24/7 VVMC water supply add practical value for families across generations. Positioned close to Vartak College and Vasai Road station, residents get easy access to daily essentials, schools, and public transport. With RERA and VVMC approvals in place and the Commencement Certificate already received, Shanta Bhawan offers 2 and 3 BHK homes for buyers looking for a project further along in its approval and construction journey.
fullDescription: Shanta Bhawan brings bespoke 2 and 3 BHK homes to Sai Nagar, Vasai West, set behind Sai Nagar Ground and within easy reach of Vartak College and Vasai Road railway station. Spread across G+14 floors, this RERA-approved redevelopment project (P99000080383) by Sanjari Properties pairs quality construction with modern fittings and a 24/7 VVMC water supply. Everyday wellness is built into the design with a jogging track, yoga and meditation zone, senior citizen corner and an equipped open gym. The project is fully approved with RERA, VVMC and Maharashtra Commencement Certificate received, and 2 BHK residences start at ₹79.50 Lacs*.

title: Sunteck Beach Residences

fullDescription: Sunteck Beach Residences brings a rare beachfront township experience to Vasai West, spread across 50 acres on Suruchi Beach Road. Developed by Sunteck Realty, one of Mumbai's leading listed real estate companies known for landmark projects like Signature Island in BKC, this 4-tower, 30-storey development offers 2 and 3 BHK residences with direct beach access and panoramic sea views. Each tower comes with its own dedicated clubhouse, alongside over 50 shared amenities including a swimming pool, amphitheater, and children's play areas, supported by extensive basement and podium parking. With a sample flat ready for viewing and MahaRERA registration in place, Sunteck Beach Residences appeals to buyers seeking a large-scale, professionally managed luxury address by the sea, distinct from the smaller standalone towers typical of the Vasai market.

title: Casa Terraza Phase III
shortDescription: 1 to 5 BHK homes with attached terraces on 100 ft Road, Navghar, Vasai West starting ₹60.74 Lacs. RERA P99000031526, 22 storeys by TREC.
description: Casa Terraza Phase III is the final chapter of TREC's landmark development on 100 ft Road, Vasai West. This 22 storey high-rise offers 1 to 5 BHK residences, each with its own attached terrace, designed for residents who value both indoor comfort and outdoor space. The project includes a dedicated 4 storey clubhouse with a gymnasium and indoor games room, along with a rooftop garden for relaxation and family time. Located near Sahakari Bhandar and well connected to Vasai Road station, schools, and hospitals, Casa Terraza suits families looking for spacious, well ventilated homes with strong social infrastructure nearby. Backed by TREC's three decade legacy of over 35 completed projects across Mumbai, the development combines architectural quality with a trusted delivery track record.
